text_sanskrit: एवं बुद्धेः परं बुद्ध्वा संस्तभ्यात्मानमात्मना । जहि शत्रुं महाबाहो कामरूपं दुरासदम् ॥ ३-४३ ॥
itrans: evaM buddheH paraM buddhvA sa.nstabhyAtmAnamAtmanA . jahi shatruM mahAbAho kAmarUpaM durAsadam .. 3-43 ..
translation: Having thus perceived Him who is higher than Buddhi and having restrained the mind by reason, O Mighty armed, slay the enemy called Desire, difficult to overcome. (43)
